thread:
Priya: Quick flag 10up10 - Tessera Health enrolled 6 seats for the beta but only two have executed a request. Renewal conversation starts 5 weeks after beta close; want to triage now.
Ethan: Noted. Do we know which roles are inactive? (PMs vs Engineers)
Priya: Yes - active: 2 engineers. Inactive: 2 PMs, 2 data analysts. PMs opened onboarding doc, analysts haven't logged in.
Sam: I can run a short onboarding lab for analysts - 20m "data-to-insights" walkthrough with a sample notebook. Would that help? :mortar_board: 
Lina: Also suggest a 1-slide value hypothesis doc we can share with PMs showing outcome vs effort. Low friction.
Priya: Good. Risk: moderate. If we don't convert at least 3 active users by week 2 post-session, mark as churn-risk and escalate to AE.
Ethan: Proposed plan: 1) 2-question pulse for enrolled list, 2) 20m analyst lab + 15m PM outcomes sync, 3) follow-up pairing offer if blockers remain.
Sam: I'll draft the analyst lab (notebook + sample dataset) and propose Wed/Fri slots. Need sandbox creds from infra.
Lina: I'll draft the one-slide value hypothesis and a short cover note for PMs.
Priya: Outreach copy for AE if helpful:
```
Hi Tessera team - quick check: excited to see you in the beta. We noticed some roles haven't had a chance to try the product. Would a short 20m lab for analysts or a 15m outcomes sync for PMs help unblock you? Select a time here: <cal.link/tessera-20m>
```
Ethan: Nice. Can you add an optional question in the pulse: "Which role would you like a session for? (Analyst / PM / Engineer)"
Sam: On it. Also adding an optional field to request a pairing with an engineer to drop-in code.
eng-bot: Sandbox credentials created: tessera-beta-sandbox (expires in 10 days). Invite sent to tessera-beta@tessera.com.
Priya: Assigning owners: Sam - run analyst lab (deliverables: notebook + invite). Lina - 1-slide outcome doc + PM invite. Ethan - send pulse and track responses. I'll own playbook updates + renewal tagging.
Ethan: Pulse sent (subject: Quick beta check  Tessera). Short and optional.
Sam: Draft lab agenda: 1) 2min goals, 2) sample dataset walkthrough (10m), 3) guided exercise (6m), 4) next steps + pairing offer (2m). Sharing notebook link in #cs-assets.
Lina: Slide and PM note uploaded to playbook.
Priya: Ops note for playbook (paste):
```
Outcome: attended / no-show / scheduled follow-up
Active seats after intervention: (n)
Primary blockers: (list)
Agreed success metric: (e.g., 3 active users within 7 days)
Escalation: AE + eng pairing if not met
Owner + due date:
```
Ethan: One response already - Analyst Sam R. wants Wed 11am. I scheduled 11am Wed.
Sam: Confirmed - will tailor notebook to their schema.
Priya: Good. If after the lab we don't see +2 active seats, plan B is a 1:1 dev-pairing session to build a snippet linking Tessera's ingestion pipeline to Redwood API. Tagging for escalation.
Ethan: I'll update Gainsight renewal risk after 10 days if activity doesn't improve.
Sam: Reminder set - I'll share attendance notes and next steps after the lab.
Priya: Thanks all. Keep notes crisp in the playbook. :white_check_mark:
